text:
sara_support: heads up — acct-6212 reporting broken completions after automatic region reroute around 07:20 UTC. responses are truncated and token counts jumped.
acct-6212: yes, our UI shows short responses and billing spiked overnight. customer id cus_6212-REDACTED.
acct-6212: repro: POST /v1/generate with model=rw-13b/latest, region=eu-west-1, same prompt used fine yesterday. now outputs half the text.
sara_support: adding logs from the API -> we saw a 200 but body has "finish_reason": "incompatible_variant" for some calls.
deploy-bot: [deploy] automatic route failover: eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 due to capacity pressure at 07:19:56 UTC. variant mapped to rw-13b-int4-lite at 07:20:01 UTC.
matt_eng: rw-13b-int4-lite is a quantized, tokenizer-slim variant; it's not fully compatible with the standard tokenizer config. this could explain mis-tokenization and different token counts.
jlee_sre: latency note — cross-region calls from EU to us-east introduced added latency ~220ms but that shouldn't truncate content. looks like variant behavior.
acct-6212: example curl and response we saw:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_cus_6212" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-13b/latest","input":"Explain the algorithm step by step"}'

Response: 200 OK
{ "id":"gen_123","output":"Explain the algorithm", "finish_reason":"incompatible_variant", "tokens": 42 }
```
sean_pm: customer impact: product QA blocked, they say prompt returned incomplete text and more tokens billed. requesting urgent rollback of mapping.
sara_support: billing alerted — rough estimate extra tokens 30k from repeated retries overnight. CC finance?
matt_eng: quick triage — looks like automatic routing fallback used an optimized runtime variant without the extended tokenizer mapping. we should not route legacy requests for rw-13b/latest to rw-13b-int4-lite.
jlee_sre: check routing policy — fallback policy is set to model_family_match with allow_substitutes=true for capacity emergencies. we need a safety check for tokenizer_compatibility flag.
matt_eng: agreed. immediate mitigation: update routing rule to prefer eu-variants and if substituting, only allow variants with tokenizer_hash == parent_tokenizer_hash. I'll open an infra PR to block int4-lite for family rw-13b until tokenizer adapter is ready.
sean_pm: customer requests rollback to previous mapping at 07:18 UTC. any ETA?
matt_eng: rolling mapping back now, will force route to eu-13b-v1 (non-quant) for cus_6212 and similar tenants. ETA ~12 min.
sara_support: letting customer know, offering one week credit while we investigate. :pray:
acct-6212: thanks, please keep me posted. also can we get the raw tokenization outputs for last 24h?
jlee_sre: grabbed sample tokenizer diffs — sending snippet:
```
# tokenization diff (prompt: "Explain the algorithm step by step")
# standard tokenizer tokens: ["Explain"," the"," algorithm"," step"," by"," step"] -> 12 tokens
# int4-lite tokenizer tokens: ["Explain the"," algorithm step by"," step"] -> 8 tokens (merged incorrectly)
# mismatch leads to early finish and different streaming boundaries
```
matt_eng: reproducer created locally against int4-lite. observed finish_reason header set by runtime when tokenizer mismatch triggers safety cutoff. this is a bug in the variant adapter.
sara_support: next steps summarized for support ticket: 1) rollback mapping for affected customers 2) block int4-lite substitution in routing 3) eng to patch adapter to check tokenizer and tokenizer_hash before allowing substitution 4) provide customer tokenization diffs and apply billing credit.
sean_pm: tagging infra/serving and eng-runtime for patch priority P1.
matt_eng: I'll push hotfix and a conservative rollback. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/routing/changes/492 (internal).
jlee_sre: monitoring rules added for "finish_reason: incompatible_variant" and sudden token_count > baseline. alert channel: #incidents.
sara_support: customer notified: "we're rolling back your traffic and investigating; we've applied a temporary credit and will follow up with root cause and timeline."
acct-6212: appreciated. can you confirm when billing is adjusted?
sara_support: finance looped in, will confirm once credit posted.
acct-6212: one more Q — why did auto-failover pick a variant with different tokenizer? is that a config drift?
matt_eng: short answer: config allowed substitutes by family only; tokenizer compatibility wasn't surfaced as a required attribute. not a drift but a policy gap.
sean_pm: follow-up action: add tokenizer_hash to model catalog metadata and bake into substitute eligibility check. also run a spot-check sync across regions.
deploy-bot: [route-update] mapping rollback complete at 07:30:04 UTC for tenant cus_6212.
sara_support: closing loop here for now, will update thread after ENG posts PR and finance confirms credit. :white_check_mark:
